# dsh-sdk-mcp v0.6.0-rc.2

## Release status

- Candidate tag: `v0.6.0-rc.2`
- npm package: `dsh-sdk-mcp@0.6.0-rc.2`
- Primary npm dist-tag: `next`
- npm registry note: because this is the first and only published version,
  npm also maps `latest` to it until a stable release replaces that tag
- Supported DSH release channel: `0.1.2-rc.1`
- Observed upstream alpha: `0.1.3-alpha.1` (not claimed compatible)

## Highlights

- Uses the official DSH 0.1.2 `sdk` profile and top-level SDK launch API.
- Installs the exact matching DSH CLI instead of requiring the obsolete
  `dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-demo` runtime.
- Preserves explicit command/argv custom runtimes through a shell-free
  compatibility launcher.
- Aligns pnpm's DSH/Cordis peer graph with the 0.1.2 release train and allows
  30 seconds for cold DSH initialization on Windows.
- Keeps persistent sessions, bounded parallel execution, Git worktree
  isolation, review metadata, and deterministic integration across exactly
  eight MCP tools.
- Adds a Cursor configuration example and refreshes the competitive and
  roadmap positioning.

## Gate status

The full keyless suite, package audit, fresh npm install, real provider-backed
runtime path, and exact-artifact Codex host gate are green. Codex CLI 0.153.4
exposed exactly eight tools, returned verified health, completed delegate and
same-session continue with retained context and zero delegated tool calls,
left the disposable workspace empty, and shut down with zero relevant orphan
processes. Claude Code remains unverified for this RC.

The verified artifact was published as `dsh-sdk-mcp@0.6.0-rc.2` on 2026-09-06.
The npm `next` tag points to this version, and a clean registry install passed
version, bundled-runtime, eight-tool discovery, `dsh_health`, stdout-purity,
and clean-shutdown checks. The repository's `npm-publish` GitHub environment
and `publish-npm-rc.yml` workflow are registered as the Trusted Publisher for
future releases.
